title.zh: Bithumb 内部移动办公系统遭外部入侵并泄露用户与员工数据
title.en: Bithumb internal mobile groupware breached, leaking customer and employee data

current_state.zh: Bithumb内部Daou Office移动办公系统遭外部非授权访问，泄露规模已确认为6444名用户（其中844人信息可读）及715名员工/合作方信息；交易所账户、资产与交易系统未被入侵，相关访问已被阻断、系统已停用，并已向韩国监管机构完成申报。
current_state.en: Bithumb's internal Daou Office mobile system was breached by an unauthorized external party, with confirmed exposure limited to 6,444 users (844 readable) and 715 employee/partner records; exchange accounts, assets and trading systems were not compromised, access was blocked, the system was disabled, and the incident was reported to Korean authorities.

updates.title_zh: 韩国第二大加密交易所Bithumb确认发生安全漏洞
updates.title_en: South Korea’s Second-Largest Crypto Exchange Bithumb Confirms Security Breach
updates.what_changed_zh: Bithumb 确认，一个未经授权的外部方入侵了其内部移动群件系统并泄露了个人数据，该事件于 10 月 27 日被发现，目前正与未来资产环球投资和大信证券的网络入侵事件一并调查，后者泄露了 38,490 名客户的数据，韩国金融监督院正在审查这三起案件。
updates.what_changed_en: Bithumb confirmed that an unauthorized external party breached its internal mobile groupware system and leaked personal data, an incident discovered on October 27 that is now under investigation alongside cyber intrusions at Mirae Asset Global Investments and Daishin Securities, the latter exposing data on 38,490 customers, with South Korea's Financial Supervisory Service reviewing all three cases.

updates.title_zh: Bithumb更新黑客事件后续：共有6444名用户信息被盗，大部分用户信息无法读取
updates.title_en: Bithumb更新黑客事件后续：共有6444名用户信息被盗，大部分用户信息无法读取
updates.what_changed_zh: Bithumb公布了泄露的具体规模：共6444名用户信息受影响，其中5600人信息已加密无法读取、844人信息可读；另有715名员工/合作方人员信息泄露，涉及姓名、手机号、邮箱、居民登记号、驾驶证号、银行账号等，并已完成向韩国互联网振兴院及个人信息保护委员会的事故申报，同时加强了异常交易与出金实时监控。
updates.what_changed_en: Bithumb quantified the exposure: 6,444 users' data affected (5,600 encrypted/unreadable, 844 readable) plus 715 employee/partner records including names, phone numbers, emails, resident registration numbers, driver's license numbers and bank account numbers; the company reported the incident to KISA and the Personal Information Protection Commission and tightened real-time monitoring of abnormal transactions and withdrawals.
updates.current_state_zh: Bithumb内部Daou Office移动办公系统遭外部非授权访问，泄露规模已确认为6444名用户（其中844人信息可读）及715名员工/合作方信息；交易所账户、资产与交易系统未被入侵，相关访问已被阻断、系统已停用，并已向韩国监管机构完成申报。
updates.current_state_en: Bithumb's internal Daou Office mobile system was breached by an unauthorized external party, with confirmed exposure limited to 6,444 users (844 readable) and 715 employee/partner records; exchange accounts, assets and trading systems were not compromised, access was blocked, the system was disabled, and the incident was reported to Korean authorities.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Bithumb disclosed that an unauthorized intrusion into its internal Daou Office mobile system exposed personal data of 6,444 users — though 5,600 of those records are encrypted and unreadable, leaving 844 readable — along with 715 employee/partner records, while stating that exchange accounts, assets and trading systems were not compromised and that the incident has been reported to Korean authorities.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Bithumb disclosed that an unauthorized intrusion into its internal Daou Office mobile system exposed personal data of 6,444 users — though 5,600 of those records are encrypted and unreadable, leaving 844 readable — along with 715 employee/partner records, while stating that exchange accounts, assets and trading systems were not compromised and that the incident has been reported to Korean authorities.

updates.title_zh: Bithumb披露内部系统遭入侵：6,444名客户和715名员工信息泄露
updates.title_en: Bithumb Details Internal System Breach: 6,444 Customers and 715 Employees Compro
updates.what_changed_zh: Bithumb disclosed that an external intrusion into its internal DaouOffice groupware on October 27 exfiltrated personal data of 6,444 customers — including names, phone numbers, resident registration numbers, bank accounts and ID documents, with 844 records directly exposed — plus 715 employee records, while stating that trading systems and asset databases were isolated and customer funds remain secure.
